content.description: Iteration 3: refine best it02_s00 (S 1.047): more sidewalk seeking (M10a), less swarm clustering (M3/var_to_mean), stronger early start, box settings from it02_s03.

driver_archetypes.rationale: M1/car (0.70-0.72 s vs 0.39 s) and M5/length (38 m vs 13 m): tau 0.5 and minGap 1.0 shorten the car discharge headway; impatience 0 keeps M3/share/car near 0.003.
M1/car: a minority with near-minimum tau pulls the mean headway toward 0.39 s; no red-running attributes, so M3/share/car stays low.
Same as it02_s00 (best S): minimal tau/minGap and full lateral freedom for M1/moto, M5/moto_density and M4/overshoot_share; impatience 0.6 with jmDriveAfterRedTime 5 s for M3/share/moto.
Small slow group kept at 5% for behaviour 10 (M6/approach moto, M4/lat_moto already close at 7.19 m); speedFactor 0.9 avoids adding to the queue length M5/length.
M10a/per_cycle (0.03 vs 0.27, weight 0.1): slightly larger custom1 seeker group, which also feeds M3/per_cycle through red running; same fast-discharge parameters so M1/moto is not worsened.
M7a/release_time and M7b/clear_lag: it02_s03 settings (release 0.62 s, clear_lag 5.1 s) were better than it02_s00 (release -11.9 s); keep jmTimegapMinor 1.0 and minGap 0.5 for M7a/n_waiting.

traci_rules.rationale: M2/early/moto (0.025 vs 0.13): most attempts end 'red_ended_before_crossing' and only about 40% execute, so p rises 0.5 to 0.9 to lift the early-start share; cars excluded (M2/early/car 0.001).
M3/per_cycle (1.6 vs 4.4) and M3/share/moto (0.038 vs 0.092): p0 up to 0.35; M3/var_to_mean (3.1 vs 1.3) is too clustered, so k drops to 0.03 and p_max to 0.6.

M10a/per_cycle (0.03 vs 0.27): p_sidewalk 0.06 to 0.15 raises sidewalk use; p_right_lane stays 0.01 since M9a (0.34 vs 0.33) and M9b/share_blocked are near target; p_wrong_lane 0 as it is inapplicable on this net (R27).
M7a/release_time (0.6 vs 2.59 s) and M7c/slope: the 2 s extra hold delays box exit after the opposing green end; M7b/clear_lag stays near 5-6 s.
Behaviour 10: slow riders stay at lane centre; unchanged because M4/lat_moto (7.19 vs 7.085 m) is already close.

reasoning: Refine best it02_s00: more sidewalk seeking, less swarm clustering, stronger early start, box settings from it02_s03, slightly faster car discharge.
